translation_notes: The predicate is an f-string hole spliced INSIDE the SPARQL angle brackets (`<{EX_P}>`), i.e. textual query assembly; in ldpy this becomes {URIRef(EX_P)} as the whole predicate term (term-position interpolation, an initBindings entry) inside s{ SELECT ?s ?o WHERE { ?s {URIRef(EX_P)} ?o } ORDER BY ?s } -- no query text is concatenated, and EX_P (a bare str) is wrapped in URIRef(...) because a plain string interpolated in term position would coerce to a Literal, not an IRI.

Also translated the two isolated g.add() calls (add_isolated, same region) to a single +{ } with two `.`-separated triples: most-specific construction per INSTRUCTIONS_403 SS2, not left as raw rdflib .add().
ordered=True in the driver because the region's own query specifies ORDER BY ?s.
